name: real_inner_le_norm
result.type: ∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x y : F), inner ℝ x y ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Real Inner Products
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in a real inner product space $F$, the inner product $\langle x, y \rangle$ satisfies $\langle x, y \rangle \leq \|x\| \cdot \|y\|$.

name: InnerProductSpace
Core
norm_inner_le_norm
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {F : Type u_3} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : Module 𝕜 F]
  [c : PreInnerProductSpace.Core 𝕜 F] (x y : F), ‖inner 𝕜 x y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
result.value:
:=
  nonneg_le_nonneg_of_sq_le_sq (mul_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _) (sqrt_nonneg _)) <|
    calc
      ‖⟪x, y⟫‖ * ‖⟪x, y⟫‖ = ‖⟪x, y⟫‖ * ‖⟪y, x⟫‖ := by rw [norm_inner_symm]
      _ ≤ re ⟪x, x⟫ * re ⟪y, y⟫ := (inner_mul_inner_self_le x y)
      _ = ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by simp only [inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]; ring
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Inner Product Spaces
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in a pre-inner product space $F$ over a real closed-like field $\mathbb{K}$, the absolute value of their inner product satisfies $|\langle x, y\rangle| \leq \|x\| \cdot \|y\|$, where $\|x\| = \sqrt{\operatorname{Re}\langle x, x\rangle}$ denotes the norm induced by the inner product.

name: norm_inner_le_norm
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
  (x y : E), ‖inner 𝕜 x y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
result.value:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) x, norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) y]
  letI : PreInnerProductSpace.Core 𝕜 E := PreInnerProductSpace.toCore
  exact InnerProductSpace.Core.norm_inner_le_norm x y
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Inner Product Spaces
result.informal_description: For any vectors $x$ and $y$ in an inner product space $E$ over a real closed field-like scalar field $\mathbb{K}$, the absolute value of their inner product is less than or equal to the product of their norms, i.e., $|\langle x, y \rangle| \leq \|x\| \cdot \|y\|$.

name: norm_le_norm_sub_add
result.signature: ∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a b : E), ‖a‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ + ‖b‖
result.type: ∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a b : E), ‖a‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ + ‖b‖
result.informal_description: For any elements $a$ and $b$ in a seminormed additive group $E$, the norm of $a$ is less than or equal to the sum of the norm of $a - b$ and the norm of $b$.

name: nndist_vsub_vsub_le
result.signature: (p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : P) : nndist (p₁ -ᵥ p₂) (p₃ -ᵥ p₄) ≤ nndist p₁ p₃ + nndist p₂ p₄
result.type:
∀ {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : PseudoMetricSpace P]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddTorsor V P] (p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : P), nndist (p₁ -ᵥ p₂) (p₃ -ᵥ p₄) ≤ nndist p₁ p₃ + nndist p₂ p₄
result.value: := by simp only [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, NNReal.coe_add, ← dist_nndist, dist_vsub_vsub_le]
result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Vector Subtractions in Normed Additive Torsors
result.informal_description: For any points $p_1, p_2, p_3, p_4$ in a normed additive torsor $P$, the non-negative distance between the vector subtractions $p_1 - p_2$ and $p_3 - p_4$ satisfies the inequality $\mathrm{nndist}(p_1 - p_2, p_3 - p_4) \leq \mathrm{nndist}(p_1, p_3) + \mathrm{nndist}(p_2, p_4)$.

name: MeasureTheory
eLpNorm_sub_le
result.signature:
{f g : α → E} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
  eLpNorm (f - g) p μ ≤ eLpNorm f p μ + eLpNorm g p μ
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {p : ENNReal}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f g : α → E},
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ →
      1 ≤ p → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (f - g) p μ ≤ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ + MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g p μ
result.value: := by simpa [LpAddConst_of_one_le hp] using eLpNorm_sub_le' hf hg p
result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Extended L^p Seminorm
result.informal_description: For any measurable space $\alpha$ with measure $\mu$, functions $f, g : \alpha \to E$ that are almost everywhere strongly measurable, and real exponent $p \geq 1$, the extended $L^p$ seminorm satisfies $\|f - g\|_{L^p} \leq \|f\|_{L^p} + \|g\|_{L^p}$. This inequality holds in the extended non-negative real numbers $[0, \infty]$, where the seminorm is defined as $\left(\int \|f(a)\|^p \, d\mu(a)\right)^{1/p}$.
